description: The map \(x\mapsto x^2\) on \(\mathbb R\) is not surjective onto \(\mathbb R\); its range is exactly \([0,\infty)\). It is not injective, since \(1^2=(-1)^2\) and \(1\ne-1\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.SetsAndMaps.square_map_codomain_example :
  (¬Function.Surjective fun x => x ^ 2) ∧
    (Set.range fun x => x ^ 2) = {y | 0 ≤ y} ∧ (¬Function.Injective fun x => x ^ 2) ∧ 1 ^ 2 = (-1) ^ 2 ∧ 1 ≠ -1
